notes: Simulation study; design inferred as mixed/other since no design is named. Sexual activity strata (number of partners) were treated as a behavioral risk variable, not an SPD, so the six-stratum RR comparison is not groupwise. RRs are reported within each transmission scenario, which is a modeling assumption rather than a stratifying variable.
